decision.observation: This pink-shell pillar chamber matches the known dark alcove past the lit pocket: pink shell fossils on the right wall, dark pillars, mossy rubble bank, dripping moss ceiling, and inert green glow dots. Hornet stands among the pillars with 3 of 6 masks filled.
decision.hypothesis: This chamber is a dead end; its only exits are back through the lit green gap to the west. Earlier, a distinctive dark temple-like ruin with pale shell-fossil columns (with a green glow) was glimpsed beyond the upper-left of the region past the pale creature — likely an unexplored route (possibly toward Bone Bottom).
decision.memory: Unexplored landmark: dark temple ruin with pale fossil columns, seen up-left from the pale-creature chamber area. Route: head west through the lit gap, then up-left.
